description: A private spa the size of an ordinary apartment, walled floor-to-ceiling in book-matched grey stone that runs unbroken from the wet-room floor up into the five-metre dark. One whole wall is glass, the bay and the mountains laid out and unable to look back in, and a monolithic soaking tub sits cut from a single block of that same stone, deep enough to vanish into. A frameless rain shower and a hidden steam vent stand off to one side; a floating basin, a concealed toilet, warm bronze fittings that have never once dripped. The floor is heated, the air is soft, and nothing up here makes a sound it doesn't mean to. The privacy bolt seats with a single soft note, like a struck bell.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
